conventions.convention: Crossing signs use det(over tangent, under tangent) in the oriented projection plane. The downward right-over-left Artin crossing is positive. In its southwest-to-northeast over-strand chart, D₀ is the left/right through smoothing and D∞ is the top/bottom cup-cap smoothing, respectively the bracket A- and B-smoothings.
The universal ring is S = Z[a±¹,z,d±¹]/(z(d−1)−(a−a⁻¹)); z is not inverted. The extension is T = S[q±¹]/(q−q⁻¹−z), with ρ=a and δ=d.
P(empty)=1, adjoining a trivial circle multiplies P by d, and positive/negative curls multiply P by a/a⁻¹. For nonempty diagrams D=P/d, L(A,Z)=−iʷ(−1)ᶜD(−iA,iZ), and F=A⁻ʷL.
Regular isotopy permits planar isotopy and Reidemeister II and III; type I is represented by scalar curl relations rather than imposed as isotopy.

Boundary endpoints have cyclic order 1,…,n,bar(n),…,bar(1). Open strands run from the smaller endpoint to the larger and are traversed by increasing initial endpoint; closed components follow. Descending means every crossing is first encountered over.

The algorithm accepts exactly its canonical ASCII grammar with n≥1 and valid generator indices. Empty words are allowed; the empty-link rank n=0 is rejected. Ambient link invariance is asserted under full AC, separately from finite computations.

load_bearing.statement: The natural map S→T is injective and T is a free S-module with basis 1,q. With ρ=a, δ=d and z_B=q−q⁻¹, the BMW coefficient relation holds and the specified skein, curl, untwisting and loop coefficients agree without dividing by a skein parameter.

For every n≥2, the assignments of BMW generators to the specified crossings and adjacent cup-cap tangles extend to a unital T-algebra homomorphism Φ_n. The scalar assignments define the boundary homomorphisms at n=0,1. No surjectivity or injectivity is asserted here.

For every n≥0, the Dubrovnik tangle algebra over T is spanned by one loop-free, self-crossing-free totally descending tangle for each connector, including the empty representative at n=0 and straight strand at n=1.

The closure-pairing determinant is nonzero in S, its image is a non-zero-divisor in T, and the standard matching tangles are linearly independent over T. No independence after arbitrary nonflat specialization is claimed.
For every n≥0, the abstract presented BMW algebra over T has a finite matching-indexed basis, of size N₀=1 and N_n=(2n−1)!! for n≥1, independently of the proposed Dubrovnik tangle map.
For n≥1, τ_n(x)=d⁻ⁿP(closure Φ_n(x)) is a cyclic T-linear trace. Its tower, positive stabilization, negative stabilization and cup-cap factors are respectively 1, ad⁻¹, a⁻¹d⁻¹ and d⁻¹.

For every nonempty oriented regular diagram, D_K(a,z)=−i⁻ʷ⁽ᴷ⁾(−1)ᶜ⁽ᴷ⁾L_K(ia,−iz). L is independent of reversing whole components, the stated local rules hold, and F=A⁻ʷL is invariant under planar isotopy and all oriented Reidemeister moves.

concerns.concern: Definition Step 4 says to retain segment labels and their designated endpoints through smoothings, then start each closed component at its least-labelled segment. Smoothing can cut one labelled polygonal segment into multiple surviving pieces, potentially on different components; its original designated endpoints need not remain endpoints of those pieces. No subdivision/relabeling or tie-breaking rule is specified. The claimed deterministic traversal needs this bookkeeping clause; the procedure-properties proof 1.2 assumes it is already determined.
